decisions.reason: As a close design variant of the core drainage range in a growing market, it likely stays above the firm's aspiration threshold and uses existing capabilities with little resource strain despite only limited website prominence.

This product is closely related to the established offer, had its own product page, and fits the firm's design-and-installation positioning, so management would likely retain it while results continue to develop.

Although more technically uncertain and niche than the other launches, it still builds on the firm's drainage know-how and available organisational slack makes retention more likely than immediate withdrawal.
A tileable floor drain with its own page sits squarely within the firm's core business and current architectural trend toward integrated bathroom solutions, making continuation the likely choice.

As an incremental stainless steel design extension with a dedicated page, it strengthens the aesthetic side of the existing portfolio and is unlikely to fall sufficiently below aspiration levels to be dropped soon.
